evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Amy: 'Let's do a virtual walkthrough so I can assess the size of your move... then I'll give you an estimate that you can depend on.' (Framing present but rushed into logistics without explicit wait for yes)
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Amy asked: square footage (~5000 sq ft), moving day (October 3rd), zip code (78654 local move), and approximate size via downsizing conversation. All four covered.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Home is 5000 sq ft (well over 1,800 threshold). Amy correctly offered virtual walkthrough: 'Let's do a virtual walkthrough so I can assess the size of your move.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Amy: 'I just have a quick question aside from the pricing. What are you most worried about for this upcoming move? Do you have any specific concerns?' — Asked but only after 10+ minutes of probing (address, dates, donation drop-off location, walkthrough scheduling already covered).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Sue raised concern: 'just make sure that everything is well packed and we box the most of everything... the furniture, the electronic stuff... take it apart and put it back together in a safe manner.' Amy responded: 'Of course, of course our movers are trained to handle your belongings as if they were their very own and we have you in the packet we have a shake wrap, moving blankets and best to protect your belong.' No follow-up dig (no 'tell me more about that'), single acknowledgment and pivot.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Amy acknowledged the concern with reassurance but did not reflect back: 'So what I'm hearing is...' format.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial. Covered: property type (house), floor/stories (two-story), square footage (5000 sq ft), starting address (285 Chimney Cove Drive, Marble Falls), destination address (300 Hawk Neck Road, Briarwood, Marble Falls), and additional stops (ARK warehouse donation drop-off, 800 Industrial Boulevard). Did NOT ask: number of rooms, walking distance, room access. Special considerations partially addressed (downsizing/donating 80%, no disposal service available). Six of seven items touched; gaps on room count and access.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Amy did not say: 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Amy did not mention typical box count for a home this size or ask about overflow items (china, book collections, etc.).

top_strength: Amy correctly identified a large move (5,000 sq ft, 2-story) and properly routed it to a virtual walkthrough rather than attempting an on-call estimate, with clear next steps and calendar invite confirmation.
coaching_note: Delay the concern-discovery question until after the walkthrough scheduling is confirmed, and when concerns do surface, dig at least one layer deeper (ask 'tell me more about that') rather than reassuring and moving on.
